available_observables.text: Fraction of labeled batches with visible curl at handoff from the existing log.
Station humidity trace recorded by R4.
Identity reads and timing recorded by R3.
Manual damper position and fan state logged for each comparison interval.

case.causal_return_path_hypothesis: Hypothesis: the return duct carries moisture back from the handoff station and promotes label curling; no causal direction is stipulated as observed.

hard_constraints.text: Every batch retains its original label identity through handoff.
The station remains inside the existing footprint; no added floor area.
A proposed comparison must keep batch arrival rate and handoff window fixed.

observations.text: Synthetic stipulated baseline: the fan is on and the return duct is open during routine handoff.
In the baseline log, curled labels occur after some handoffs; this does not establish a causal direction.
A supply grille and a return grille connect the station to the same circulation loop.
Protected anomaly: one logged fan-on interval has no curled labels despite the same arrival rate.
The batch identity scanner still reads intact labels when the recirculation fan is manually stopped.
No return-only intervention has been logged; stopping the fan changes more than the return link.

parent_operations.text: Supply operation moves air from the fan outlet to the station through the supply grille.
Return operation moves station air through the return duct back to the circulation loop.

case.preferred_dependency: R1 recirculation fan operating through the return duct

resources.text: Existing recirculation fan with on/off control
Manual damper on the return duct; the supply grille can remain open
Existing station humidity logger with interval stamps
Clip frame that can hold a label away from the station surface

unknowns.text: Whether station moisture follows the return link or follows label contact with the surface.
Whether the anomaly reflects a hidden environmental variable; no mechanism is proved.
Whether a fan-free construction can preserve the fixed handoff window across all stipulated arrivals.

case.valued_outcome: Keep the labeled batch legible at the handoff station without missing the stipulated handoff window.
